interpretation: First recorded 5/5 run where both the no-template communication driver and the XY control(state) module were written by a real model (claude-haiku-5-5) and passed the unchanged isolation gates.
XY motion during trials was executed by the generated module (455 XY actions; 72 control-phase model calls were for scene/goal/lift/grip/verify tools).
Each generated program failed its first gate once (driver: malformed-reply rejection; controller: start near travel limit) and was fixed by the model after the test feedback.
Task preconditions and image verifiers are still pre-written; one seed, one device family (P2), development seed. Not evidence for G3, unseen devices, or generalization.
